intro: An Edmonton law firm helping individuals, families, entrepreneurs and businesses navigate important legal decisions with clear advice and efficient processes.

services: Practical legal support for business owners, entrepreneurs and organizations.

teamText: Lawyer Philip Lopatka and legal assistant Nicole May Parent are listed on the firm’s team page. The firm uses a team-based approach to coordinate legal and administrative support.
